title: The Categories picker searches, selects all and shows each category's matrix
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix B, pricing a new category made for this test, category B.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click matrix A's name on the Matrices list.
  3. Click Edit.
  4. Open the Categories picker.
  5. Type the first letters of category B's name in the picker's search.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Matrix A is listed.

Step 2:

  • Matrix A's page opens.

Step 3:

  • The Categories picker shows.

Step 4:

  • A list of categories opens with a search box, a Select all control and a checkbox per category.
  • Uncategorized is not in the list, while the other categories are.

Step 5:

  • Category B is listed with "Now:" and matrix B's name beside it.
